messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: what laptop to buy ?
parts:
Dear all,

I am about to buy a new laptop and was wondering which one to get. I am prepared to pay about 3000 USD. 

I want it to be performant for stuff we talk about on this list (i.e., JAGS, NIMBLE, sims in R, ...) and so I thought I want a fast processor and 64 GB RAM. My current favourite is a DELL XPS, of which I can get a 16' machine with 1 TB HD, 64 GB RAM and some late i9 processor for that price. Alternative might be an HP Z book.

Any thoughts or advice ? (Note: I do NOT want a gamer machine.)

Thanks and best regards  ----  Marc

messages.author: 352904662ed7b7cc
messages.subject: Re: what laptop to buy ?
parts:
Hello Marc,

I went with the ThinkPad P1 Gen 5 (16″ Intel) mobile workstation last year (32 GB RAM, i7 processor, and 1 TB SSD) and have really enjoyed it. I, too, did not want a gaming laptop and had a bad experience with a Dell laptop prior to purchasing the ThinkPad. That being said, I've had good luck with Dell machines, but prefer ThinkPads.

I see that it is no longer available, but the ThinkPad P14s Gen 5 Intel (14″) Mobile Workstation (~$2500) looks really nice and it can be customized to include a 2 TB SSD hard drive and 96 GB of RAM. One advantage to this laptop (which is my only complaint about my current laptop), is that the "Ctrl" and "fn" buttons are in the standard place on the keyboard.

Good luck!

Alexej
